claims.statement: Management intends to build fulfilment centres quickly in large towns to achieve a 12-hour delivery aspiration for DMart Ready.
claims.quote: We should do whatever it takes to build fulfilment centres in large towns quickly, as quickly as possible so that we are able to deliver in at least 12 hours. I mean, that's the aspiration.

claims.statement: Management expects blended average gross margins to continue ranging between 14.5%, 15%, and 15.5%.
claims.quote: I think 14.5%, 15%, 15.5%, those are the kind of ranges we play in from a gross margin standpoint.

claims.statement: Management anticipates that the GMA contribution for the current financial year will be equal to or better than FY 24.
claims.quote: With a reasonable confidence, I can say that, this financial year will be equal to or better than FY '24 GMA contribution.
claims.target: equal to or better than FY 24

claims.statement: Management believes that the apparel category can return to pre-COVID contribution levels over time.
claims.quote: apparel we believe we can go back to the older days of contribution, which was maybe pre-COVID.

facts.statement: Avenue Supermarts has 29 percent of its store cohorts in towns with a population of less than 5 lakhs.
facts.quote: We’ve got 1% better in less than 5 lakh town population, we were at 28% of the store cohorts in FY '23, it's become 29%. So, we have 29% of our store cohorts in less than 5 lakh population towns.

facts.statement: DMart Ready EBITDA margins currently operate at minus 2 percent to minus 3 percent.
facts.quote: EBITDA margin is still minus 2% to minus 3%.

facts.statement: The Mumbai Metropolitan Region is fully covered by DMart Ready except for a couple of unserviceable pin codes.
facts.quote: MMR, Mumbai Metropolitan Region, we are fully covered.

facts.statement: Minimax is currently treated as an ongoing format experimentation as the market is not yet ready for it.
facts.quote: It's still an experimentation. We feel that the market is not yet ready for that model.
